notifications.cart-line-removed: Removed from your cart because it is no longer available: {name}.
notifications.wishlist-item-removed: Removed from your wishlist because it is no longer available: {name}.
notifications.cart-merge-refused: Some items from your guest cart are no longer available and were not added: {lines}.
notifications.cart-merge-refused-bare: Some items from your guest cart are no longer available and were not added.
notifications.fulfillment-delayed: Part of your order ({titles}) is delayed: it was promised for {agreed} and is now expected on {expected}. If you are happy to wait you do not need to do anything; you can cancel it from your order.
notifications.fulfillment-delayed-undated: Part of your order ({titles}) is delayed: it was promised for {agreed} and we are still waiting for stock. If you are happy to wait you do not need to do anything; you can cancel it from your order.
notifications.fulfillment-held-check_address: Part of your order is on hold: please check its delivery address.
notifications.fulfillment-held-delayed: Part of your order is held back for a moment and will leave later than planned.
notifications.shipment-lost-lost: A parcel of your order was lost on the way. We will send it again, or refund you if you prefer.
notifications.shipment-lost-damaged: A parcel of your order was damaged on the way. We will send it again, or refund you if you prefer.
notifications.shipment-lost-owed: We have to restock part of it: {titles} is expected around {expected}.
notifications.stock-alert: Good news: {name} can be ordered again.

staff.purchase-hold-placed: A buyer's checkout was paused until {until} after repeated cancellations. Review the account if you suspect abuse.
staff.webhook-disabled: A webhook subscription was switched off after repeated delivery failures. Fix the endpoint, then re-enable it.
staff.ticket-opened: New ticket: {what}. Open it to take it.
staff.ticket-assigned: A ticket was given to you: {what}.
staff.return-requested: A buyer asked to return goods. The request is waiting for a decision.
staff.outbox-dead: An event ({event}) could not be delivered after every retry and was parked. Look at the record it was about.
staff.transfers-due: {n} bank transfers are due soon. Open the orders to chase them.
staff.preorders-late: {n} preorders are past their expected date with units still owed.
staff.delivery-holds-open: {n} orders have been held for too long. Fix the reason or release them.
staff.withdrawals-awaiting-goods: {n} withdrawals are waiting for their goods to come back.
staff.returns-undecided: {n} return requests still need a decision.
staff.unshipped: {n} paid orders have not shipped yet.
staff.awaiting-tracking: {n} shipped parcels still have no tracking code.
staff.undelivered: {n} parcels were shipped and never marked arrived. Until then the buyer's withdrawal window has not started.
staff.stale-refunds: {n} refunds have been open too long. Check them against the provider.

notifications.staff-ticket-kind-paid_without_hold: Paid order without a stock hold
